title: Re-scope transformation plan: protocol definitions only, implementations in separate repos
body:
PR #369's transformation plan incorrectly proposed building drivers and plugins within the spec repository. This repo defines protocols (Zod schemas, TypeScript types, JSON schemas) — implementations belong in separate plugin repositories.

## Changes

**V2 Documents** (protocol-focused)
- `TRANSFORMATION_PLAN_V2.md` — 31 protocol definition tasks for this repo, references to 17+ implementation repos
- `TECHNICAL_RECOMMENDATIONS_V2.md` — Complete Zod schema examples for missing protocols (GraphQL, Encryption, Cache, etc.)
- `IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKLIST.md` — Part A: protocol work (this repo), Part B: driver/plugin work (separate repos)
- `EVALUATION_SUMMARY.md` — Architecture clarification and document navigation
- `DOCS_NAVIGATION.md` — Guide to all documents with reading paths

**Architecture Separation**

```
THIS REPO (objectstack-ai/spec)          SEPARATE REPOS
├─ Zod schemas                           ├─ objectstack-ai/driver-postgres
├─ TypeScript types (z.infer<>)         ├─ objectstack-ai/driver-mysql
├─ JSON Schema generation                ├─ objectstack-ai/plugin-encryption
└─ Protocol documentation                └─ objectstack-ai/connector-salesforce
```

**Protocol Work Identified** (this repo)
- **P0**: SQL/NoSQL driver protocols, encryption, compliance, multi-tenancy, GraphQL (11 protocols)
- **P1**: Object storage, message queue, search, vector DB, AI model registry (9 protocols)
- **P2**: Logging, metrics, tracing, time-series, graph DB (7 protocols)

**Example Protocol Definition**

```typescript
// packages/spec/src/system/encryption.zod.ts
export const EncryptionConfigSchema = z.object({
  enabled: z.boolean().default(false),
  algorithm: z.enum(['aes-256-gcm', 'aes-256-cbc', 'chacha20-poly1305']),
  keyManagement: z.object({
    provider: z.enum(['aws-kms', 'azure-key-vault', 'gcp-kms']),
    rotationPolicy: KeyRotationPolicySchema.optional(),
  }),
  deterministicEncryption: z.boolean().default(false),
});
```

Original documents archived as `.backup` files for reference.
